sources.name: Image Dataset of Accessibility Barriers
sources.publisher: Alexander von Humboldt Institute for Internet and Society
sources.author: Jakob Stolberg et al.
sources.annotation_format: CVAT image XML manual bounding boxes
sources.download: Only selected ZIP members, using verified HTTP ranges and per-member size/CRC32
sources.group_policy: Retain CVAT annotation task as conservative group; this is not a verified capture session
sources.original_split: Source default subset has no train/validation/test split
caveats: Steps include doorstep, curb and other vertical transitions; original type attribute is retained.
Handrails refer only to grab bars serving stairs or ramps, not fences or complete guardrails.
Only visible sloped or incremental surfaces are annotated.
Height and width attributes are subjective visual estimates, not metric ground truth.
No complete 25-class annotation or source-provenance approval is inferred.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons elevator photograph candidates
sources.annotation_format: none; category retrieval is not a box annotation
sources.license_policy: Explicit individual CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or public-domain declaration with author and source URL
sources.group_policy: Author and capture day are conservative grouping hints, not verified sessions
sources.integrity: Original photo SHA1 matches Commons imageinfo; local SHA256 stored
